identity.binding: every counted held-out observation must quote exactly one conforming exact_model_config object together with its exact_model_config_id, and observations taken under two different conforming objects are never pooled into one cell
identity.exact_model_config_id_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(exact_model_config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True), first 32 hex characters, prefixed with g13emc2-
identity.unspecified_field_policy: no field may be omitted and no field may be null. A model configuration that cannot state a value is not an exact configuration.

json_schema.title: EVAL-131 exact model configuration, G13 freeze v2

provider.description: inference provider identifier, for example anthropic or openai

model_id.description: provider-side model identifier as sent on the wire

model_version_or_snapshot.description: the pinned snapshot or dated version; a floating alias is not an exact configuration

reasoning_effort.description: off rather than none: a frozen identity spec must contain no token the freeze verifier reads as an unfilled slot

min_distinct_exact_model_configs_source: EVAL_131_QUALIFICATION_PROTOCOL v1.0 as restated in docs/evidence/g13/QUALIFICATION_CRITERION.md; the coordination branch was unreachable from this worker environment and wins if it says otherwise
